Gather.StaminaCost.doc: The lightning-bolt '5' label under an overworld resource pickup (ore rock, sand pile, ...) once the character is near: each pickup costs 5 stamina (R-106). The pickup sits about 33 px above the label. Not a screen state; used by sxs.gather.

Gather.Bellflower.doc: A Bellflower plant on the Verdantglade map (white bells on a green stem; Moonveil Woods field). Harvesting one is free and adds 1 to the item tracker. Not a screen state; used by sxs.gather harvest. Template is mae's picture at 1.3x; at 0.6 it finds all 5 plants in world/explore_bellflower_field_wide.png and nothing on ore, boar, tracker or world-map screens (2026-11-04).

Home.VendorBooth.doc: Molly's Vendor Booth wagon on the home scene (green leaf roof, clay pot on top), between the Goddess Statue and the gate; the house is further right. Not a screen state; used by sxs.vendor. Cropped at night lighting (2026-11-04).
